gui.taczexpands.paint.title: Paint
gui.taczexpands.paint.hue_help: Changes the color family within the range allowed by this finish.
gui.taczexpands.paint.saturation_help: Changes color intensity. Lower values make the finish grayer.
gui.taczexpands.paint.brightness_help: Changes brightness. Lower values keep dark finishes dark.
gui.taczexpands.paint.pattern_mix_help: Blends the pattern into the base color: 0% is solid color, 100% is full pattern.
gui.taczexpands.paint.pattern_scale_help: Changes camouflage pattern size within the recipe range. Higher values make the pattern larger.
gui.taczexpands.paint.picker_help: Click to open or close the color picker. Only recipe-allowed axes can change.
gui.taczexpands.paint.color_fixed: This base color is fixed by the recipe.
gui.taczexpands.paint.picker_plane_help: Drag horizontally for saturation and vertically for brightness. Locked axes stay unchanged.
gui.taczexpands.paint.preview_hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
